title: prangos serpentinica
intro: Prangos serpentinica, commonly known as Sereh, is a type of plant that belongs to the Carrot family (Apiaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including respiratory and gastrointestinal problems, due to its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Prangos serpentinica include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. The health benefits of Prangos serpentinica include relieving coughs and colds, reducing fever, and soothing digestive issues, making it a popular herbal remedy in traditional medicine.
